scope: patent sources: what did the new channels actually add?

epo_enumeration.note: the sitemap gives publication reference + application reference + IPC for every publication without fetching documents; front pages are needed only for applicants, titles and abstracts

epo_document_roles.note: A3 search reports and B8 corrected title pages are not new technical disclosures; counting them would inflate the corpus

cross_source_independence.method: normalise priority numbers to digits; join CIPO EP-origin priority claims against the EP application numbers held in this sample
cross_source_independence.normalisation_note: raw string matching yields 0 matches purely because EPO omits separators and CIPO includes them, e.g. '124163' vs '569,842' — that 0 would have been an artefact, not a finding
cross_source_independence.why: the intersection is computed against 228 EP applications only. Even if every CA patent had an EP counterpart, the chance that the counterpart is inside a 228-application sample is ~1e-5 per record. A null result here says nothing about whether the corpora overlap; it says the sample is too small to test.
cross_source_independence.what_would_be_needed: to measure real EPO/CIPO overlap, enumerate all EP application numbers in the relevant filing window from the sitemap (free) and intersect — that is a tier-1 operation costing sitemap requests only, not document fetches
